newsitem.title: USA: Telident says refocusing, names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Telident says refocusing, names new CEO.

text.p: Telident Inc said it named Edward McConaghay president and chief executive, replacing Michael Miller, who resigned effective April 1.
McConaghay also was elected a member of the Telident board, said the maker of hardware and software systems, primarily for the enhanced 911 emergency calling network.
McConaghay most recently was president and chief executive of Digital Technics Inc, a Maryland-based telecommunications company, Telident said.

Telident said, "The company is undertaking initiatives to more closely align operating expenses with Telident's new direction. Initiatives include reducing staff and redirecting the sales force, as well as lowering corporate administrative expenses."

New initiatives will include targeting specific, high-potential customer segments, focusing sales efforts in states such as Texas, Colorado and Illinois, where enhanced 911 access has been mandated, continuing to work with the U.S. Federal Communications Commission to ensure nationwide improvements in the 911 emergency calling network, and other measures, the company said.
